problem_restatement.question: Which exact V58 provider-symbol-side routes generate source-compatible prospective opportunity, and do any new lifecycles update their pre-window evidence tier?
problem_restatement.stakeholder_goal: Collect evidence for a four-crypto/four-noncrypto successor without changing the active V57 backend or treating roster size as proof of edge.
success_criteria: all eight symbols and ten provider-symbol routes emit production-equivalent readiness telemetry
every eligible intent is withheld with observe_mode_no_execution
route conclusions remain separate and source compatible
preactivation readiness seeds are excluded from prospective counts
losses, censored paths, sparse sides, and zero-trade routes remain reported

window.preactivation_policy: exclude readiness seeds and decisions before the observer run activation
window.selection_policy: no route, side, parameter, or horizon may be selected from this future window

observer_candidate.interpretation: Execution fields freeze counterfactual strategy semantics; observe mode grants no execution authority.

measurement_contract.opportunity_conflicts: report same-symbol overlap and occupancy displacement

evidence_thresholds.diagnostic_update: at least one attributable eligible decision and one technically resolved lifecycle per configured side
evidence_thresholds.change_recommendation: at least ten technically complete source-compatible lifecycles per route, at least three per configured side, exact after-cost nominal and stress results, and largest-winner sensitivity
evidence_thresholds.interpretation: These thresholds define evidence sufficiency for a recommendation; they do not abort trials or create automatic execution authority.

route_change_policy.rejected_routes: remain rejected unless materially new independent source-compatible evidence falsifies the recorded disposition
route_change_policy.contradictory_routes: remain research-only until the prospective window resolves the contradiction
route_change_policy.retained_routes: continue under their current identity; this observer does not retune them
route_change_policy.unknown_or_sparse: insufficient evidence is reported as insufficient, not success or failure

risks_and_failure_modes: The observer can establish signal cadence and readiness while still lacking complete executable lifecycle evidence.
A small number of wins or losses can be dominated by one outlier.
Different route windows and same-symbol occupancy make summed weekly frequency invalid.
Source gaps, mark gaps, stale depth, or missed funding events can censor a path.
The staged V58 sizing and leverage are not authorized by this report-only window.
validation_plan: run the observer once with a bounded smoke ledger and require all eight symbols and ten provider-symbol routes
start a fresh continuous isolated ledger only after the bounded run exits successfully
run a public event recorder for any symbol lacking prospective trade, mark, and depth evidence
audit the observer ledger for zero actions, zero orders, complete provider coverage, and causal decision timing
compare future lifecycle results only to the frozen pre-window disposition
falsifiers: Any observer row has live_armed true, non-none execution authority, a routed action, order, or fill.
The config or source hashes differ from this preregistration before the run begins.
A preactivation or future-received decision enters the prospective count.
Route-level data are pooled into a V58 profitability claim.
A live strategy, risk, sizing, leverage, asset, or execution configuration changes without explicit human approval.
